[P2] Approach: provide the required design rationale

The description explains the new scenario and existing exporter limitation, but does not state which simpler alternatives were considered or why they were rejected. Rule 2.5 explicitly requires that explanation when adding logic, and rule 3 requires it in the design note for a new feature. Requirement and JS-handler references do not supply those decisions in this description. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, document the alternatives and chosen approach, and obtain maintainer agreement before proceeding.
